systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Training, with UNICEF and HISP Uganda support under GPE KIX
systems.tiers: schools report through its data collection tools; more than 900 school administrators and focal teachers trained on the updated tools

note: The document describes the DHIS2-based EMIS only as data collection instruments through which schools report learners by stream, grade, age and sex and functional difficulties; it states no per-learner record that schools add to during the year, so the system as described here is class census and gives no fact.
